company.name: Stromy
company.description: Stromy is an AI orchestration partner that designs and builds analytical workflows — from media research and share-of-voice analysis to public-affairs monitoring, crisis management, and strategy audits — turning unstructured processes into structured, trust-grade, publication-ready outputs for corporates and consulting agencies. Stromy operates across Australia and the Netherlands.

credentials._note: No formal awards/accreditations published; proof points live in proposals/case-studies + stats (40+ skills, 8 MCP servers, 35+ gov API tools).

people.name: William Masquelier
people.title: Co-Founder — Applied AI & Agentic Systems
people.publicBio: William builds the substance: the agentic systems, MCP skills, and AI workspaces that turn strategy into tools teams actually use. An economics graduate with a double master's in financial and behavioural economics from Erasmus University Rotterdam, he developed LLM-driven analysis prototypes at Hill+Knowlton Strategies, advised corporates on digital transformation at PwC, and built analytical frameworks at Duke Strategies.

people.name: Corentin Merlé
people.title: Co-Founder — AI Architecture & Infrastructure
people.publicBio: Corentin designs the architecture: the AI infrastructure and systems that Stromy's tooling runs on. A data science and engineering graduate of the University of Liège, he wrote his thesis on retrieval-augmented generation for enterprise use at Safran. As a data scientist at GAMING1, he leads AI adoption across the organisation.
